description: This source file implements a Raspberry Pi display and surface management system with input handling, EGL surface creation, and communication with a compositor. It includes platform-specific code for display and cursor management, input event callbacks, and RPC connection setup.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: Platform abstraction for display and cursor management, with platform-specific implementations for VC6 and non-VC6 environments.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Represents a display device, manages surfaces, input, and RPC connections, and handles display operations.

classes.name: SurfaceImplementation
classes.description: Implements a surface on the display, managing EGL surfaces and input event forwarding.

classes.name: RemoteAccess
classes.description: Implements the IClient interface for a surface, managing properties like opacity, geometry, and Z-order.

methods.name: VirtualKeyboardCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual keyboard input, sends key events via pipe.

methods.name: VirtualMouseCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual mouse input, sends mouse events via pipe.

methods.name: VirtualTouchScreenCallback
methods.description: Callback for virtual touchscreen input, sends touch events via pipe.

methods.name: Display::Process
methods.description: Processes input messages from the pipe and dispatches them to surfaces.

methods.name: Display::Create
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified name and size.

methods.name: Display::Register
methods.description: Registers a surface with the display.

methods.name: Display::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a surface from the display.

methods.name: Display::OfferClientInterface
methods.description: Offers a client interface to the RPC compositor.

methods.name: Display::RevokeClientInterface
methods.description: Revokes a client interface from the RPC compositor.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::Opacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::Geometry
methods.description: Sets the geometry of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::ZOrder
methods.description: Sets the Z-order layer of the surface.
